record.tooling: any OpenAI-compatible client against https://api.inceptionlabs.ai/v1, or the vendor SDKs (pip install inceptionai, npm install inceptionai)
record.chaining: a large one-off token grant with a high per-minute ceiling, suited to a burst of batch calls before any paid plan; the grant, not the rate, is the scarce link
